name: NeedleBench V2
intro: NeedleBench V2 是双语合成长上下文评测框架。信息稀疏分支把虚构单针、多针和 2–5 条亲属事实插入中英文填充文本；信息密集 ATC 生成连续亲属链并扩展到 2–512 条针。两条分支使用不同解析与汇总指标，官方上下文配置覆盖 4k–1,000k。
build_method: 虚构事实与亲属链合成, 受控深度插入, 双分支任务生成
metric: S-RT/M-RT 采用关键词感知匹配；M-RS 论文为 boxed+关键词匹配、固定代码为 boxed 清洗+严格相等；论文定义 ATC 加权准确率与 ENL-50，固定 V2 仅逐针数精确分数
task_type: 长上下文检索, 多步推理, 祖先追溯
eval_feature: 信息稀疏与信息密集, 4k–1,000k, ATC, 双语
task_type_en: Long-context Retrieval, Multi-step Reasoning, Ancestral Trace
build_method_en: Fictional-fact and Kinship-chain Synthesis, Controlled-depth Insertion, Dual-branch Task Generation
eval_feature_en: Information-sparse and Dense Tasks, 4k–1,000k, ATC, Bilingual
intro_en: NeedleBench V2 is a bilingual synthetic long-context framework. Its sparse branch inserts fictional single needles, multiple needles, and two-to-five-fact kinship problems into English and Chinese filler; the information-dense ATC generates continuous family chains with 2 to 512 needles. The branches use distinct parsing and aggregation metrics, and official context configurations span 4k to 1,000k.
metric_en: S-RT/M-RT use keyword-aware match; M-RS uses paper boxed+keyword-aware versus fixed-code boxed cleanup+exact equality; paper-defined ATC weighted accuracy and ENL-50, fixed V2 per-N exact scores only

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit fixed on 2026-07-18. The primary paper is arXiv:2407.11963v3, published in TMLR in September 2025; the reviewed PDF has SHA-256 ae377912652f19703f25b3bd5eaab80bb844fcfe9ce9f1b4428588e8177245d0. Sections 3.1-3.2, Equations 1-4, Appendix E, Appendix F, and Appendix G were checked against the diagram. Official implementation semantics were checked at OpenCompass commit 34da831f41494ebc3ece902fc9200dbba696a93e, including opencompass/datasets/needlebench_v2, the V2 configuration README, 4k through 1,000k configs, and the ATC power-of-two config. The benchmark deliberately creates synthetic, fictional facts and kinship relations to avoid overlap with real-world or pretraining knowledge and provides English and Chinese versions. The information-sparse branch has three tasks: S-RT retrieves one fact, M-RT retrieves multiple facts, and M-RS integrates two to five kinship facts. English filler comes from PaulGrahamEssays and Chinese filler from ChineseDomainModelingEval; irrelevant filler is not used in ATC. Needles are inserted at controlled depths, while V2 configurations span 4k, 8k, 32k, 128k, 200k, 256k, and 1,000k contexts. Inputs use the GPT-4 tokenizer and a length buffer to keep trailing instructions visible across model tokenizers. Each length/depth configuration is repeated ten times. S-RT and M-RT use keyword-aware exact match: any predefined core keyword in the prediction earns full credit. The paper's M-RS contract first extracts boxed content and then applies keyword-aware exact match. The fixed V2 configs instead reuse the ATC evaluator, which performs boxed cleanup followed by exact string equality; the diagram records this paper/code scoring drift. Each task is averaged over context lengths, depths, and repetitions; V2 uses the simple equal mean of S-RT, M-RT, and M-RS rather than the earlier weighted task aggregation. The information-dense ATC branch contains no irrelevant filler. Algorithm 1 samples n+1 unique names, creates a sequential family chain of n relationship statements, assigns each random relationship a generation weight of one or two, randomizes bilingual templates, sums the generation distance, shuffles all statements to remove positional bias, and joins them into continuous text. Four question types are supported: eldest ancestor, N-th ancestor, N-th descendant, and relationship distance, each with programmatically derived gold. V2 scales ATC by powers of two from 2 through 512 needles and repeats each configuration ten times. The model must return the final answer inside a boxed expression. Released postprocessing calls extract_boxed_answer; if found, it removes LaTeX wrappers, slashes, quotes, tildes, and redundant spaces, while a missing boxed answer becomes None. The released evaluator trims prediction/reference strings and requires exact equality. Equation 4 defines the paper-defined needle-count-weighted accuracy, and ENL-50 is the largest tested needle count whose exact-match accuracy remains at least 50%. The fixed V2 configs expose per-needle-count exact scores only and wire no Equation 4 aggregator; the legacy opencompass/summarizers/needlebench.py uses an unrelated 60% rule and is not connected to the V2 configs. Sparse-task and ATC results are reported separately; the paper does not define one combined score across both information-density branches. Release boundary: the fixed OpenCompass repository is Apache-2.0 and publishes V2 generation/evaluation code, configs, prompts, and README. Its configs refer to a separate opencompass/needlebench data payload that is not tracked in the Git tree; this boundary is shown explicitly without claiming the data-generation contract is absent. Formal publication evidence [site-a11x-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3570×865 (English) and 3565×865 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3568×863 and 3563×863. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
